notes.title: Questing Update!
notes.notes:
Questing Update! - Patch 1.28

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36973073/0cebca55609c2c606ea3b92509b8765f9a90b0c3.png

The much anticipated Quest Update is finally live! We've added 7 new quests, a whole host of new items, a new cave dungeon, a complete overhaul to the guildwork skill and a new boss fight. So far this has been the biggest update we've ever done for Damascus and we are very excited to share it with you all!

Guildwork can now be done with skilling! Contracts award guild points which can be spent at the Guild Master in Dominia, go check it out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36973073/be85f3bad95c24fdc8a77479673a30dbbbd703de.png

Patch 1.28
========================================
General
+ Added the Plasma Vial Package to the Dragon Plasma Store on Punk Hazzard.
+ Added the Airtight Vial Package to the Explosives Components Store on Punk Hazzard.
+ Added a Bank next to the furnaces and anvils on Regular Island.

+ Relocated the Cosmetic Wardrobe to the cosmetic room in Dominia.

+ Added the Copper Conundrum quest.
+ Added the Actually Actuators quest.
+ Added the Bone and Bow quest.
+ Added the Some Goblins Want To Farm quest.
+ Added the Intro to Damascus quest.
+ Added the Punks of Hazzard quest.
+ Added Gemstones to the game. They can be acquired through mining Gemstone Rocks and require a Mining level of 50.
+ Added Ancient Green Dragons to the game. They have a combat level of 302 and attacks with Melee.
+ Added Ancient Blue Dragons to the game. They have a combat level of 303 and attacks with Melee.
+ Added Ancient Red Dragons to the game. They have a combat level of 305 and attacks with Melee.

Players are awarded Guildwork Points for completing a task. Players get 10 points for an easy task, 20 points for a hard task, 30 points for a hard task and 50 points for a boss task. + Added the Actuator Pouch to the Guildwork Store. It stores actuators. It costs 2000 points.
+ Changed the Chef Hat to be a cosmetic item.
+ Added enemy collectible cards to the game. They are dropped from monsters. Normal Cards have a 1 in 100 drop rate and Foil Cards have a 1 in 1000 drop rate.

+ Changed the Scarf sprite due to a request from the original owner.
Bug Fixes
+ Fixed a bug where if the player's Survival level was lower than 30 they would not receive the extra 30 invisible levels when cooking with a Chef Hat.
+ Fixed a bug where the Chef Hat would not work when cooking on a fire.
+ Fixed a bug where the northernmost Gold Rock by Cactorio was incorrectly placed.
+ Fixed a typo in the Destruction tooltip for Psychic Pulse and Kinetic Pulse.
+ Fixed a bug where having men or women as your Guildwork task would not count certain men and women towards your task.
+ Fixed a bug where players could not finish the Smuggling Situation quest.
Balance Changes
+ Replaced the Damascus Pickaxe with the Damascus Scimitar on the Demon Prince drop table.
+ Replaced the Plasma Belt with the Cursed Claws on the Cursed Yeti drop table.
+ Have reworked the way multi combat drops work. Any player qualifies for a guaranteed drop once they have inflicted damage greater or equal to 5% of the enemy's max health. This guaranteed drop does not include the boss-specific rare drops. Everyone who inflicted more than the 5% threshold will qualify for a chance to get the boss-specific rare drop with the players who dealt the most damage getting the highest chance and the players who dealt the least getting the lowest chance. Only one player will get a roll for the boss-specific drop.

Patch 1.24
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36973073/f219f5b0b4598d2ca222dc5314ae4c8a949e94a4.png

Ferrymen are offering travel to the dangerous and illustrious Punk Hazzard. An island on the East coast of Rogues Rest that is treacherous to travel to due to the many islands which cause shipwrecks. Punk Hazzard is a cursed island where toxic gasses constantly plague the locals, however amongst all the danger there are many treasure to be found!

General
+ A new island named Punk Hazard has been added to the game. It can be found east of Dockthda. It is a poisonous island and the player will take 5 damage every 10 ticks if they are not wearing the full Hazmat Suit. Players can either travel from Dockthda or Icewyntale to get there.

+ Sulphur Deposits have been added to the game. They can be found at Punk Hazard. They require level 50 in Mining to mine.

+ The Enchanted Heart has been added to the game. It is used when making E. Damascus items. It has a 1 in 300 chance of dropping from the Cursed Yeti.
+ E. Damascus melee items have been added to the game. They require 5 of the relevant Damascus item as well as an Enchanted Heart to make.

notes.title: Friends List Update!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.23

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36973073/b0acf6c3170244b1867139ae1abf39c8fca28238.png

Friends list baby!

It is a truly momentous occasion. The long awaited friends list has been added. You and your mates will be able to have some quality banter in game without having to be in the same vicinity as each other. With this comes a revamp of the chat menu as well as the ability to ignore other players which essentially mutes any player that might get on your nerves.

The friends list is rather simple. You can either add a friend through the social tab or you can right click on another player and add them through the "Add Friend" option. When both you and your friend have added each other you will then be able to see when they are online and gain the ability to private message each other. You can message your friends by clicking on their username in the friends list when they are online (green for online, red for offline).

The chat has also undergone a rework. There are now 4 different categories of chat. Game chat (which shows in game notifications), public chat (which shows chat from players in their vicinity), private chat (which shows a player's private messages to their friends) and all chat (which shows all of the above in one chat). Players can also use the "tab" key to switch between their current private chats with their friends.

5 new cosmetics as well as 3 previous popular cosmetics have been added to Shalk's Cosmetic Store. The Chicken Ring has replaced the Ring of Wool, the Shield of Love has replace the Reindeer Antlers, the Cat Ears have replaced the Goblin Outfit, the Ghost Outfit has replaced the Candy Cane Sword, the Big River Staff has replaced the Demon Tail, the Cloak of Romance has replaced the Krampus Mask, Super Luci has replaced the All White Cape and the Jon Suit has replaced the Ring of Christmas. Their prices can be found below:

Chicken Ring - 500 CC
Shield of Love - 1000 CC
Cat Ears - 1500 CC
Ghost Outfit - 2000 CC
Big River Staff - 2500 CC
Cloak of Romance - 4000 CC
Super Luci - 4500 CC
Jon Suit - 5000 CC

Happy grinding!

+ Players can private message a friend if they are online by clicking on their name in the friends list.
+ Players can press "tab" to cycle through their private chats with friends. This only works when players are in focus in the chat input. Therefore press "enter" first and then "tab" to avoid any confusion.

Patch 1.22

Players will be able to choose which mode to player once they have outfitted their character in the Character Creation menu after creating a new account. The details are as follows:

Multicombat Update! - Patch 1.19

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36973073/015761c78498d363df8f045e7247b4bd6a0ad2d7.png

Multicombat has arrived to Damascus! A new island has been discovered to the north of Cactorio and the Guilds have taken to conquering new land. However enemies do not respect the honourable 1 on 1 combat that we are all used. It is the survival of the fittest.

The guild is having a bit of trouble subjagating the inhabitants of the island. They discovered a broken down portal where the Demon Prince and his Lieutenants are and urgently need assistance. There are said to be grand rewards for slaying the Demon Prince and even his Lieutenants have a few themselves.

They have also found some Corrupted Rocks which can be mined to get Demonic Shards.

+ The Ring of Wool has replaced the Fireworks Package.
+ The Goblin Outfit has replaced the Potato Head.
